cim: New Artificial Analysis index widens the gap between open and closed models
cim_eredeti: New Artificial Analysis index widens the gap between open and closed models
szoveg_eredeti:
Artificial Analysis overhauled its Intelligence Index, causing Kimi K3.1 Pro to drop five spots in the rankings. The model originally launched in fourth place, but it falls to ninth behind eight closed models in version 5. Artificial Analysis now puts the gap between open models and the top of the leaderboard at 12 points, up from 3 points previously.

For the first time, 60 percent of the index relies on private test sets to prevent "benchmaxxing," the practice of training models specifically on known test questions. Kimi K3.1 Pro's drop suggests the old index made some models look better than they were. Grok 4.7 also lost 12 points.

AI researcher Nathan Lambert thinks benchmaxxing is only part of the story. Many training gains today happen in reinforcement learning environments with tasks that resemble the benchmarks. Keeping up across multiple domains at once takes sophisticated RL infrastructure, and not every lab has it.Ad

Closed test sets do have a downside, since outsiders can no longer spot errors in the prompts. The AA-Omniscience knowledge test proves those errors exist. Artificial Analysis had to revise ambiguous and flawed questions in that benchmark for the new index.Ad
